structured.answer: I can take it out tax-free 6 years after the first deposit, and with about 300 ₪ a month from me and 900 from my employer I'd have around 66,000 ₪ in hand. I'm not sure if that number is for year 5 or year 6.

The final-amount bar number is cut off at the left edge ('66,5…')
The final amount is given as a range (66,601 to 66,280) and it isn't clear which year it is for
Tax goes out and then partly comes back (29,768 vs 15,794), which is confusing and scary
